rationale: I read the complete held working text of the order, both history observations (a 2026-10-15 Federal Register API disposition note and a 1989 printed codification row), and the acting text. The two observations are editorial leads and are not the basis; the basis is the acting instrument's own held text. EO 11925 has one operative paragraph: it amends Executive Order 11554 of August 29, 1970, as amended, by replacing the date June 30, 1976 with September 30, 1978. It contains no independent command, so its life is that of the amended order. Executive Order 12082 (signed 1978-09-19, held text at 43 FR 42727) section 1-103 orders that Executive Order Nos. 10616, 11151, 11437 and 11554, as amended, are revoked, with no delayed effective date or savings clause in the held text. EO 11554 as amended includes the 11925 change, so the only clause of 11925 ended on 1978-09-19 by revocation of the instrument it amended; even on the narrowest reading its own substituted date, September 30, 1978, ended it long before 2026-10-14. EO 12082 does not name 11925; the reason it ended 11925 is that it revokes 11554 as amended. Partial scope: one clause, checked. No earlier ending located in the held texts (no search of the full corpus is claimed).
